description: This Java interface defines a contract for a request object that encapsulates a set of acknowledgement requests with optional filtering, used in a domain-specific acknowledgement mechanism within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: FilteredAcknowledgementRequest
classes.description: An interface representing a request for domain-specific acknowledgements with optional filtering, providing JSON serialization/deserialization and accessors for included acknowledgements and filters.

classes.name: FilteredAcknowledgementRequest.JsonFields
classes.description: An internal utility class containing JSON field definitions for the 'includes' and 'filter' fields used in the JSON representation of the acknowledgement request.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of FilteredAcknowledgementRequest with specified includes and optional filter.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a FilteredAcknowledgementRequest from a JsonObject.

methods.name: getIncludes
methods.description: Returns the set of acknowledgment requests included in this request.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the filter string if present.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the request into a JsonObject, with an overload that accepts schema version and field selector.
